verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 42.6
verses.english: Linked Discourses 42.6

verses.pali: 1. Gāmaṇivagga
verses.english: 1. Chiefs

verses.pali: Asibandhakaputtasutta
verses.english: With Asibandhaka’s Son

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṁ viharati pāvārikambavane.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Nāḷandā in Pāvārika’s mango grove.

verses.pali: Atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Asibandhaka’s son the chief went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchā bhūmakā kāmaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā udakorohakā aggiparicārakā.
verses.english: “Sir, there are western brahmins garlanded with aquatic flowers who carry pitchers, immerse themselves in water, and serve the sacred flame.

verses.pali: Te mataṁ kālaṅkataṁ uyyāpenti nāma saññāpenti nāma saggaṁ nāma okkāmenti.
verses.english: When someone has passed away, oh! they lift them up, send them well, and convey them to heaven.

verses.pali: Bhagavā pana, bhante, arahaṁ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṁ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjeyyā”ti?
verses.english: But what about the Blessed One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha: is he able to ensure that the whole world will be reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm when their body breaks up, after death?”

verses.pali: “Tena hi, gāmaṇi, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya tathā naṁ byākareyyāsīti.
verses.english: “Well then, chief, I’ll ask you about this in return, and you can answer as you like.

verses.pali: Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, gāmaṇi,
verses.english: What do you think, chief?

verses.pali: idhassa puriso pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
verses.english: Take an individual who kills living creatures, steals, and commits sexual misconduct. They use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical. And they’re covetous, malicious, and have wrong view.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ mahājanakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya:
verses.english: A large crowd were to come together to offer up supplication and entreaty, circumambulating them with cupped palms and saying:

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatū’ti.
verses.english: ‘When this person’s body breaks up, after death, may they be reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm!’

verses.pali: Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, gāmaṇi,
verses.english: What do you think, chief?

verses.pali: api nu so puriso mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikā anuparisakkanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjeyyā”ti?
verses.english: Would that person be reborn in heaven because of their supplications?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “No, sir.”

verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, gāmaṇi, puriso mahatiṁ puthusilaṁ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya.
verses.english: “Chief, suppose a person were to throw a broad rock into a deep lake.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya:
verses.english: And a large crowd were to come together to offer up supplication and entreaty, circumambulating it with cupped palms, and saying:

verses.pali: ‘ummujja, bho puthusile, uplava, bho puthusile, thalamuplava, bho puthusile’ti.
verses.english: ‘Rise, good rock! Float, good rock! Float to shore, good rock!’

verses.pali: Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, gāmaṇi,
verses.english: What do you think, chief?

verses.pali: api nu sā puthusilā mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikā anuparisakkanahetu vā ummujjeyya vā uplaveyya vā thalaṁ vā uplaveyyā”ti?
verses.english: Would that broad rock rise up or float because of their supplications?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “No, sir.”

verses.pali: “Evameva kho, gāmaṇi, yo so puriso pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
verses.english: “In the same way, take a person who kills living creatures, steals, and commits sexual misconduct. They use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical. And they’re covetous, malicious, and have wrong view.

verses.pali: Kiñcāpi taṁ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya:
verses.english: Even though a large crowd were to come together to offer up supplication and entreaty …

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatū’ti, atha kho so puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjeyya.
verses.english: when their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, gāmaṇi,
verses.english: What do you think, chief?

verses.pali: idhassa puriso pāṇātipātā paṭivirato adinnādānā paṭivirato kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato musāvādā paṭivirato pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato samphappalāpā paṭivirato anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko.
verses.english: Take an individual who doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, or commit sexual misconduct. They don’t use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical. And they’re contented, kind-hearted, and have right view.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya:
verses.english: And a large crowd were to come together to offer up supplication and entreaty, circumambulating them with cupped palms and saying:

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatū’ti.
verses.english: ‘When this person’s body breaks up, after death, may they be reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell!’

verses.pali: Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, gāmaṇi,
verses.english: What do you think, chief?

verses.pali: api nu so puriso mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikā anuparisakkanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjeyyā”ti?
verses.english: Would that person be reborn in hell because of their supplications?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “No, sir.”

verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, gāmaṇi, puriso sappikumbhaṁ vā telakumbhaṁ vā gambhīre udakarahade ogāhetvā bhindeyya. Tatra yāssa sakkharā vā kaṭhalā vā sā adhogāmī assa; yañca khvassa tatra sappi vā telaṁ vā taṁ uddhaṁ gāmi assa.
verses.english: “Chief, suppose a person were to sink a pot of ghee or oil into a deep lake and break it open. Its shards and chips would sink down, while the ghee or oil in it would rise up.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya:
verses.english: And a large crowd were to come together to offer up supplication and entreaty, circumambulating it with cupped palms and saying:

verses.pali: ‘osīda, bho sappitela, saṁsīda, bho sappitela, adho gaccha, bho sappitelā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Sink, good ghee or oil! Descend, good ghee or oil! Go down, good ghee or oil!’

verses.pali: Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, gāmaṇi,
verses.english: What do you think, chief?

verses.pali: api nu taṁ sappitelaṁ mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikā anuparisakkanahetu vā osīdeyya vā saṁsīdeyya vā adho vā gaccheyyā”ti?
verses.english: Would that ghee or oil sink and descend because of their supplications?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “No, sir.”

verses.pali: “Evameva kho, gāmaṇi, yo so puriso pāṇātipātā paṭivirato, adinnādānā paṭivirato, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato, musāvādā paṭivirato, pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato, samphappalāpā paṭivirato, anabhijjhālu, abyāpannacitto, sammādiṭṭhiko,
verses.english: “In the same way, take an individual who doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, or commit sexual misconduct. They don’t use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical. And they’re contented, kind-hearted, and have right view.

verses.pali: kiñcāpi taṁ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya:
verses.english: Even though a large crowd were to come together to offer up supplication and entreaty …

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatū’ti, atha kho so puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjeyyā”ti.
verses.english: when their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Asibandhaka’s son the chief said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “abhikkantaṁ, bhante …pe…
verses.english: “Excellent, sir! …

verses.pali: ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the Buddha remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
